name: Scaffolding Zone
description: Elevated work area — highest risk zone. Full PPE mandatory at all times.

name: Ground Work Zone
description: Standard ground-level construction area. Hard hat minimum requirement.

name: Machinery Zone
description: Active heavy machinery area — full PPE mandatory due to impact and crush risk.

name: Material Storage
description: Storage and staging area. Hard hat required due to overhead load risk.

name: Site Entry / Walkway
description: General access corridor. Hard hat and vest required — workers pass through active zones.
